premises.text: Online merchants must verify shopper identity and keep personal data safe without today's exchange of PII
premises.evidence_span: They need to know that Emily is who she says she is, and once they've confirmed that she is who she says she is, they need to keep her information safe

premises.text: Patented hashing-to-graph comparison lets two parties confirm matching attributes without exchanging the underlying information
premises.evidence_span: patented software that allows two parties to confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information

premises.text: An identity exchange lets verified attribute holders publish Sidici-format data for merchants to reuse prior verifications
premises.evidence_span: get organizations that hold lots of verified identity attributes on us to convert that information into the SIDICI format, make it available on servers, so that we can then access it through an identity exchange

premises.text: Transactional fee per verification with 30% shared back to the attribute provider
premises.evidence_span: Every verification we do, we charge a fee for. But the interesting thing is we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information

premises.text: Go-to-market targets real-time fraud monitoring and identity verification, with BT building a UK identity exchange
premises.evidence_span: We're looking to compete in two specific areas, the prevention of fraud, which is real-time monitoring of credit card transactions, and the identity verification area

value.text: Prove identity and keep information safe without moving personal data between parties
value.evidence_span: help businesses prove that you are who you say you are and keep your information safe

causal_links.evidence_span: This creates a number of problems for merchants
no information left my browser, no information left the server in the bank

notes: Hash/graph micro-component comparison treated as one verification mechanism (IP detail stays inside). Identity exchange is a separately revisable network-effect module. KYC/payments/sharing-economy/age-check uses folded as applications of the same identity need (§4.1.2). BT selection treated as GTM channel condition rather than traction boast alone.
